title: Review Backlog and Due-Card Load
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vocab:review event=due
| stats sum(due_count) as due by deck
| eval overload=if(due>200,1,0)
| sort - due
description: Warns when your spaced-repetition review backlog balloons, before it becomes discouraging to catch up.
value: A runaway due pile is the number-one reason people quit flashcards; an early warning keeps it manageable.
implementation: Ingest due-card counts into `index=personal`; alert on a large review backlog.
visualization: Bar chart of due-card backlog by deck.
grandmaExplanation: It warns when your flashcard reviews pile up too high, before it feels impossible to catch up.
